description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).
Basic digit value encoding in token embeddings and position encoding in pos embeddings with xavier init.
Xavier normal init with gain 0.1, digit value and position encoding.
Column-by-column addition with explicit digit gathering via attention and sum computation via MLP lookup.
Simplified column-based addition with attention gathering digits from same column and MLP computing sum.
Column addition with carry chain through layers. D=256, L=6, H=4, FF=1024.
Carry chain through second-number positions using causal attention. D=128,L=8,H=4,FF=512. No LayerNorm.
Fixed carry chain: per-layer column-specific attention. D=128,L=8,H=4,FF=512. No LayerNorm.
Clean dim separation, position-specific carry, no LayerNorm. D=128,L=8,H=4,FF=512.
Stronger signals (S=10, P=20, W=20), cleaner logic. D=128,L=8,H=4,FF=512.
Simplified: dims 0-9 for result throughout, direct updates. D=128,L=8,H=4,FF=512.
